8234.title: DOM insertion guard dereferences an undefined append reference
8234.rootCauseOneLine: The insertion wrapper excludes only null before reading the reference parent, so undefined throws before native append conversion.
8234.proposedFix: Exclude both nullish reference values before dereferencing; retain plugin reparent protection and test native-versus-guarded append behavior.
8234.caveats: Repeated by the same investigator in two source checkouts using jsdom; released desktop, browser engines, and the full Solid plugin integration were not separately exercised.
